# Artistic Decorative Concrete

> Expert decorative concrete, flatwork, and foundation contractor serving Billings, Laurel, and surrounding Montana communities since 2006. Licensed, insured, and specializing in stamped concrete patios, concrete driveways, retaining walls, foundations, slab-on-grade, polished concrete floors, and custom stone work. Call (406) 598-2444 for a free estimate.

## About

Artistic Decorative Concrete is a family-owned concrete contractor based in Laurel, MT, serving Billings, Laurel, Columbus, Roundup, Huntley, Hardin, Forsyth, Red Lodge, Absarokee, Miles City, Big Timber, Belfry, and Bridger, Montana. Founded in 2006, the company provides residential and commercial decorative concrete, flatwork, foundations, and custom stone work built to withstand Montana freeze-thaw cycles. Services include stamped concrete, polished concrete floors, concrete driveways and patios, retaining walls, slab-on-grade foundations, concrete restoration, and custom outdoor features like fire pits and water features. Phone: (406) 598-2444. Address: 3100 S Park City Rd, Laurel, MT 59044.

## Services

- [Decorative & Stamped Concrete](https://artisticdecorativeconcrete.com/services): Stamped concrete patios, driveways, and walkways with stone, brick, and slate patterns sealed for Montana weather.
- [Patios, Driveways & Flatwork](https://artisticdecorativeconcrete.com/services): Concrete driveways, patios, walkways, and sidewalks built to handle Montana freeze-thaw cycles.
- [Stone Work & Outdoor Features](https://artisticdecorativeconcrete.com/services): Custom stone patios, fire pits, water features, and walkways for Montana landscapes.
- [Retaining Walls](https://artisticdecorativeconcrete.com/services): Engineered concrete and stone retaining walls for erosion control, drainage, and landscape structure.
- [Foundations & Slab on Grade](https://artisticdecorativeconcrete.com/services): Code-compliant footings, foundation walls, and slab-on-grade for residential and commercial builds.
- [Polished Concrete](https://artisticdecorativeconcrete.com/services): Smooth, glossy polished concrete floors for garages, basements, and commercial interiors.
- [Concrete Restoration](https://artisticdecorativeconcrete.com/services): Resurfacing and restoration to rejuvenate worn or damaged concrete without full replacement.
- [Custom Concrete Solutions](https://artisticdecorativeconcrete.com/services): Custom decorative concrete sealed for UV and weather resistance, tailored to your property.
